ns2:course.label: Orientation to Dance
ns2:course.description: Survey of the field including dance as a theatre art, careers, injury prevention and nutrition. Also serves to orient incoming students to the faculty, programs, and policies of the Department of Dance, and the production and performing resources in the Krannert Center for the Performing Arts. Prerequisite: Major standing in Dance or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Major standing in Dance or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Dance or Dance major(s).
